verdict.rationale: The product ships in the open Agent Skills format: a folder with a SKILL.md that agents read and pick up from its description. That makes its core instructions agent-oriented documentation an agent can be pointed at (gh-19, gh-22, gh-18). However, there is no evidence of an llms.txt, and the probe for a markdown docs version returned 404 (probe-1). missing for 10: an llms.txt file, agent-oriented docs about the product outside the skill payload, a working markdown docs endpoint, independent corroboration.
